answer: Why should ten masks outweigh one player? On this stage, weight is tenure etched in onyx and set in basalt: one mask held ten seasons weighs a hundred, the square of its seasons. Split the same stake across ten fresh masks and each weighs one — ten in all, a tenth of the voice for tenfold the cost. No zephyr of new arrivals can fake seasons. One honest player, one mask, stands undivided, and his seasons are his wage.
